change_reason: After protocol v3 merged and before any confirmatory ARC test access, an implementation audit found that the frozen strong-pretrained model identity was complete but its tokenizer truncation length and security-relevant loader/runtime details were not preregistered. The already-verified development DeBERTa path in PR #23 used max length 96, slow SentencePiece tokenization, trust_remote_code disabled, Transformers 4.57.6, SentencePiece 0.2.2, PyTorch checkpoint loading on Torch >=2.6 with weights_only=true. V4 freezes exactly those already-executed settings and otherwise inherits the immutable v3 scientific contract unchanged.
protocol_change_rule: V1, V2, and V3 remain immutable audit trails. V4 is the exact immutable V3 scientific contract plus only this pretrained-runtime addendum and supersedes V3 before confirmatory test access. Any later material change requires a new protocol version before confirmatory test access; observed confirmatory test outcomes may never be used to edit V1, V2, V3, or V4.
